name: Nneka Balogun-Arredondo
role: Corporate espionage and data exfiltration — data thief
location: Old Harbor — repurposed shipping infrastructure turned black market hub, near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Nneka Balogun-Arredondo is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 41, her expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rin — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a data thief out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Nneka Balogun-Arredondo is known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
psychology.secret: Ngaire Rojas-Yeboah maintains a second identity — a completely clean civilian persona with a lease, a job history, and a social profile. It's their exit strategy.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "Your firewalls are decorative. Like curtains on a submarine."
"I copy things. The original owners rarely appreciate the compliment."
"Data wants to be free. I just charge a facilitation fee."

story_hooks: A crew member from Ngaire Rojas-Yeboah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Ngaire Rojas-Yeboah owes a personal debt to
Ngaire Rojas-Yeboah is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Ngaire Rojas-Yeboah is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings. Internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on demand
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous diaspora blend of Sub-Saharan African (37.1%), Hispanic/Latin American (15.3%), South Asian (14.3%), North African (14.2%), East Asian (11.0%), and Northern European (8.1%) ancestry. This complex genetic mosaic creates a striking phenotype: warm deep brown skin with golden, olive, and subtle copper undertones from the African and North African heritage, enriched by South Asian warmth. Bone structure reflects the blend—prominent cheekbones and high orbital ridges from Sub-Saharan ancestry, squared jaw from Northern European genetics, with subtle epicanthal variation suggesting East Asian contribution. The overall effect is of someone whose ancestry defies easy categorization, each region's traits harmonizing into a distinctive whole.
physical_description.build: Stocky and densely muscled, built like someone who trains methodically. Shoulders broad and forward-set. Forearms thick with functional muscle, hands large-knuckled and calloused from years of physical work and gear maintenance.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight in a functional braid, practical rather than styled
physical_description.eye_color: Cybernetic — chrome iris rings surrounding deep brown biological pupils. Thermal overlay visible as faint amber warming beneath the metallic surface.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden, olive, and subtle copper undertones, reflecting the layered blend of Sub-Saharan African, North African, South Asian, Hispanic/Latin American, East Asian, and Northern European ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and clean. Minimal makeup. A small scar bisects her left eyebrow — old, well-healed. Jaw is squared and prominent with Northern European influence in the bone structure. High cheekbones and pronounced orbital ridges suggest Sub-Saharan African heritage. Subtle eye shape variation hints at East Asian genetics. Expression rests in neutral watchfulness, lips thin and rarely smiling.
distinguishing_marks: Linear scar running vertically through her left eyebrow, approximately 2cm long, pale against darker skin
Burn scar on the inside of her right wrist — roughly 4cm diameter, circular, silvered and old
Faint track marks along both inner elbows, well-concealed but present under close inspection — from decades of subcutaneous injection work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome cybernetic eyes with visible iris rings that catch light. The enhancement hardware sits flush with the orbital bone but unmistakably artificial. No attempt to disguise or blend them. The internal drug synthesizer leaves no visible external evidence.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight slightly forward on the balls of her feet — ready posture. Movements are economical and deliberate, no wasted motion. Hands are usually occupied with something — a tool, a device, a cigarette — rarely at rest. When still, she maintains 360-degree awareness, head turning in measured sweeps.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional aesthetic. Dark-colored utility jacket with reinforced panels and too many pockets — well-worn and maintained. Tactical cargo pants with cargo webbing. Worn steel-toed boots, laced tight. Layers underneath that can be added or removed. A subdermal armor plate is visible along her collarbone where jacket neckline sits — burnished steel panel. No corporate branding, no unnecessary jewelry. A single silver ring on her left ring finger — worn thin, possibly inherited.
